answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks by binding each identity to a sealed optical PUF built around a synthetic opal wafer. During synchronized challenge rounds, an internal laser probes it at requested angles from zenith, turning nanosphere defects into a nebula of speckles on a sensor to derive ephemeral keys. Attackers must buy and power separate photonic hardware per identity. However, remote verifiers must still trust the module's enclave not to spoof readings.
